overview: Over several decades throughout the late 19th-century and early 20th-century, Mr Arthur Chipping rises from a shy, nervous teacher to the beloved, revered headmaster of Brookfield School, with his life and career shaped by his love for his wife and his unwavering dedication to his students.
tagline: At The Top Of The Year's "Ten Best" - The picture that earns for 1939 a proud place in motion-picture history!
title: Goodbye, Mr. Chips
